This '''Jakku villager''' was a [[Gender|female]] [[human]] member of the [[Church of the Force]], who lived in the [[Tuanul]] village on the [[planet]] [[Jakku]]. Around thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]], the villager was present in the village when it was [[Attack on Tuanul|attacked]] by sixty [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtroopers]] of the [[First Order]], who were searching for the village resident [[Lor San Tekka]] and the [[Map to Skywalker|map]] fragment he possessed. The villager and her baby were then caught by [[Finn|FN-2187]] during the attack, but he spared their lives before their capture.<ref name="TFA Junior novel">''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: A Junior Novel]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This character is portrayed by [[Sasha Frost]] in the [[2015]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'' Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']]. Despite the scenes of the villager's encounter with FN-2187 were [[Content cut from Star Wars|cut from the theatrical version]], her role was confirmed in the movie's credits. She later appeared in [[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: A Junior Novel|the junior novelization]] of the film by [[Michael Kogge]], as well as [[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Graphic Novel Adaptation|the graphic novel adaptation]]. The latter noticeably provides a different version of the scene, as the villager wears entirely different attire and does not carry an infant or anything in her arms at all.
